findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read, page_extract, agent_spotlight, url_threat_check, paper_search, url_status, page_meta, robots_check, link_check, email_verify_bulk, feed_latest, link_preview · Private data: web_read, page_extract, b2b_lead_audit, ai_readiness_pack, agent_memory, qr_generate, url_threat_check, site_extract_lite, url_status, page_links, page_meta, robots_check, link_check, dns_records, email_security, security_headers, tls_cert, company_dossier, email_verify_bulk, feed_latest, link_preview · Public sink: work_mint, email_security, company_dossier, email_verify_bulk · Destructive: workflow_run, agent_memory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read, page_extract, agent_spotlight, url_threat_check, paper_search, url_status, page_meta, robots_check, link_check, email_verify_bulk, feed_latest, link_preview · Private data: web_read, page_extract, b2b_lead_audit, ai_readiness_pack, agent_memory, qr_generate, url_threat_check, site_extract_lite, url_status, page_links, page_meta, robots_check, link_check, dns_records, email_security, security_headers, tls_cert, company_dossier, email_verify_bulk, feed_latest, link_preview · Public sink: work_mint, email_security, company_dossier, email_verify_bulk · Destructive: workflow_run, agent_memory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
